K.H. GURUPRASAD Senior Business Analyst | Banking | BFSI | Payments | Investment Banking | Capital Markets |Reconciliation & Settlements Bengaluru, Karnataka, India | gururao_kh@outlook.com | 9916947414

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Immediately available to join

Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 18 years of expertise in Capital Markets, Payments, and Investment Banking operations, specializing in trade lifecycle management, reconciliation, and settlements. Proven success in bridging business and technology, driving transformation initiatives, and optimizing straight-through processing across global banking environments. Adept at eliciting complex requirements, conducting AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, and delivering scalable solutions under Agile and Waterfall methodologies. Recognized for reducing settlement fails, strengthening governance frameworks, and implementing KPI-driven dashboards for transparent decision-making. Experienced in leading cross-functional teams of up to 25 members, managing stakeholder expectations, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. Certified in Business Analysis, Agile, Power BI, SQL, SAP FI, and Leadership & Strategy, with a strong track record of delivering operational excellence and transformation in BFSI domains.

KEY SKILLS

Business Analysis: Requirement Elicitation & Prioritization, BRD/FRD Documentation, User Stories, Use Cases, UML Diagrams, BPMN, Wireframes & Mockups, Gap Analysis, Scope Definition, AS-IS/TO-BE, Process Mapping, MoSCow.

Domain: Global Trading (Front, Middle & Back Office), Trade Matching & Settlement, Capital Markets, Payments, Reference & Static Data Governance, Claims Management, Regulatory Compliance, Reconciliation.

Delivery Methodology: Agile & Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC, Sprint Planning & Review, Product Backlog Management, Release Planning, Change Request Management, UAT & Hypercare Support

Data & Reporting: SQL, Power BI (KPI Dashboards), Data Dictionary, Logical Data Model, RAID Log Management, MS Excel (Advanced)

Leadership: Stakeholder Management, Cross-Functional Team Leadership (up to 25 members), Vendor & Client Communication, Risk & Control Assessment, Project Documentation & Governance

Tools: Jira, Confluence, MS Visio, Lucidchart, Balsamiq, SAP FI, SQL, Power BI,

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Accenture, Bangalore Associate Manager (Senior Business Analyst) - Reconciliation

Dec 2025 – Jul 2026

Led business analysis for a high-volume Cash, Trade and general ledger reconciliation transformation project, aligning stakeholders across finance, compliance, and engineering

Supervised a 25-member team through mobilization and requirement-gathering workshops and stakeholder interviews (interviews, questionnaires, interface/document analysis, brainstorming, focus groups) to ensure full coverage of business needs.

Configured and tested auto-matching and auto-allocation rules, improving daily matching efficiency to 95% to 100% on- time transaction matching, trade matching, and settlement through rigorous reconciliation of internal and external data and strengthened reference/static data governance.

Facilitated requirement workshops with operational users to translate complex manual adjustment practices into structured system rules.

Facilitated daily stand-up governance forums on Jira to track milestones, align cross-functional teams, escalate blockers, and assess readiness for automating manual activities.

State Street India Pvt Ltd Manager – (Senior Business Analyst) Settlements & Operations

Sep 2021 – May 2025

• Led a greenfield Claims Monitoring process implementation across financial services, managing the end-to-end

implementation plan and delivery schedule in alignment with enterprise architecture and business strategy for global banking clients.

Supervised 14-member team through requirements elicitation and workshops; managed client dependencies across data and business teams.

Strengthened governance and controls by establishing clear data ownership, embedding traceability frameworks (RAID log of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and improving reference data accuracy, reliability, and regulatory compliance. • Designed and published KPI dashboards in Power BI, enabling dashboard-based, real-time visibility of sprint and milestone progress for transparent reporting and informed decision-making.

Facilitated Agile governance through weekly Scrum ceremonies, working-group sessions, backlog refinement, and continuous team coaching.

Ran status meetings and feedback forums with client sponsors and technical teams, aligning deliverables with business expectations and preparing status updates for leadership.

Introduced process improvements, including an internal contact management tool, reducing reliance on external data sources and streamlining stakeholder communication.

Documented user stories with acceptance criteria and traceability from requirements through testing and delivery, ensuring completeness of project artifacts and sign-offs.

Performed gap, scope, and impact analyses (UML, BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart) to define AS-IS/TO-BE processes and identify optimization opportunities.

Partnered with cross-functional teams across development, integration, and UAT, ensuring quality delivery and seamless transition into BAU.

Broadridge Financial Services Associate Project Manager (Senior Business Analyst) – Settlements

May 2017 – Aug 2021

Executed implementation of the IMPACT settlement system to extract and monitor real-time settlement status via IMAD references, improving operational visibility and accuracy.

Led AS-IS vs. TO-BE analysis, supervised an 8-member team through requirement-gathering workshops, and translated business requirements into actionable solution designs.

Partnered with Front/Middle/Back-office stakeholders to diagnose and resolve recurring trade matching and settlement fails.

Delivered a major enhancement achieving 80% on-time trade matching and settlement through rigorous data reconciliation and strengthened reference/static data governance.

Automated daily cash and securities reconciliation processes, decreasing operational reconciliation time by 4 hours per day • Coordinated UAT activities and partnered with development, integration, and functional testing teams to deliver end-to-end solutions in full compliance with business and regulatory expectations, managing client dependencies and escalations throughout.

JP Morgan Chase India Pvt Ltd Operational Analyst – Reconciliation & Settlements

Apr 2007 – Nov 2016

Ensured accurate reconciliation of trade positions by validating static data attributes, coordinating with global agent banks and data teams, and resolving discrepancies through robust reference data controls.

Coordinated large-scale securities transfers by validating reference data, static client data, and settlement instructions, ensuring alignment with market regulations and client requirements.

Conducted market restriction and eligibility checks, embedding static data validations to ensure smooth transfers and regulatory adherence.

Managed post-trade settlement activities with a focus on TMPG Claims, leveraging reference data to investigate, resolve, and prevent recurring discrepancies.

EDUCATION

MBA in Finance — Manipal University, Bangalore • Bachelor of Commerce — Bangalore University, Bangalore

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Business Analyst and Agile • Microsoft Power BI Certified Associate • SQL Certified Associate • Microsoft Excel (Advanced) Certified Associate • Certified Master of Leadership & Strategy • SAP FI Certified

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Accenture, Bangalore Associate Manager (Senior Business Analyst) - Reconciliation
Dec 2025 – Jul 2026
Led business analysis for a high-volume Cash, Trade and general ledger reconciliation transformation project, aligning stakeholders across finance, compliance, and engineering
Supervised a 25-member team through mobilization and requirement-gathering workshops and stakeholder interviews (interviews, questionnaires, interface/document analysis, brainstorming, focus groups) to ensure full coverage of business needs.
Configured and tested auto-matching and auto-allocation rules, improving daily matching efficiency to 95% to 100% on- time transaction matching, trade matching, and settlement through rigorous reconciliation of internal and external data and strengthened reference/static data governance.
Facilitated requirement workshops with operational users to translate complex manual adjustment practices into structured system rules.
Facilitated daily stand-up governance forums on Jira to track milestones, align cross-functional teams, escalate blockers, and assess readiness for automating manual activities.
State Street India Pvt Ltd Manager – (Senior Business Analyst) Settlements & Operations
Sep 2021 – May 2025
• Led a greenfield Claims Monitoring process implementation across financial services, managing the end-to-end
implementation plan and delivery schedule in alignment with enterprise architecture and business strategy for global banking clients.
Supervised 14-member team through requirements elicitation and workshops; managed client dependencies across data and business teams.
Strengthened governance and controls by establishing clear data ownership, embedding traceability frameworks (RAID log of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and improving reference data accuracy, reliability, and regulatory compliance. • Designed and published KPI dashboards in Power BI, enabling dashboard-based, real-time visibility of sprint and milestone progress for transparent reporting and informed decision-making.
Facilitated Agile governance through weekly Scrum ceremonies, working-group sessions, backlog refinement, and continuous team coaching.
Ran status meetings and feedback forums with client sponsors and technical teams, aligning deliverables with business expectations and preparing status updates for leadership.
Introduced process improvements, including an internal contact management tool, reducing reliance on external data sources and streamlining stakeholder communication.
Documented user stories with acceptance criteria and traceability from requirements through testing and delivery, ensuring completeness of project artifacts and sign-offs.
Performed gap, scope, and impact analyses (UML, BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart) to define AS-IS/TO-BE processes and identify optimization opportunities.
Partnered with cross-functional teams across development, integration, and UAT, ensuring quality delivery and seamless transition into BAU.
Broadridge Financial Services Associate Project Manager (Senior Business Analyst) – Settlements
May 2017 – Aug 2021
Executed implementation of the IMPACT settlement system to extract and monitor real-time settlement status via IMAD references, improving operational visibility and accuracy.
Led AS-IS vs. TO-BE analysis, supervised an 8-member team through requirement-gathering workshops, and translated business requirements into actionable solution designs.
Partnered with Front/Middle/Back-office stakeholders to diagnose and resolve recurring trade matching and settlement fails.
Delivered a major enhancement achieving 80% on-time trade matching and settlement through rigorous data reconciliation and strengthened reference/static data governance.
Automated daily cash and securities reconciliation processes, decreasing operational reconciliation time by 4 hours per day • Coordinated UAT activities and partnered with development, integration, and functional testing teams to deliver end-to-end solutions in full compliance with business and regulatory expectations, managing client dependencies and escalations throughout.
JP Morgan Chase India Pvt Ltd Operational Analyst – Reconciliation & Settlements
Apr 2007 – Nov 2016
Ensured accurate reconciliation of trade positions by validating static data attributes, coordinating with global agent banks and data teams, and resolving discrepancies through robust reference data controls.
Coordinated large-scale securities transfers by validating reference data, static client data, and settlement instructions, ensuring alignment with market regulations and client requirements.
Conducted market restriction and eligibility checks, embedding static data validations to ensure smooth transfers and regulatory adherence.
Managed post-trade settlement activities with a focus on TMPG Claims, leveraging reference data to investigate, resolve, and prevent recurring discrepancies.
